description: Sabotages the public-surface test of the reading layer's entries (tests/reader_public_items.rs) must refuse at build time: an item made private, or no longer exported, fails to compile the test, which is how that file notices. Run with tools/run-sabotage.ps1; see tools/README-sabotage.md for the format.

sabotages.name: ReadSq::drain is no longer public
sabotages.why: A client reads the SQ through it.

sabotages.name: ReadSq::capacity is no longer public
sabotages.why: A client sizes its draining by it.

sabotages.name: ReadSq::doorbell is no longer public
sabotages.why: It is the event the client waits on.

sabotages.name: ReadSq::reset_doorbell is no longer public
sabotages.why: The client resets the doorbell before it drains.

sabotages.name: ReadSq::resume_doorbell is no longer public
sabotages.why: It is the event the layer waits on for room.

sabotages.name: ReadSq::ring_resume is no longer public
sabotages.why: It is how the client says it has made room.

sabotages.name: Data::chunk is no longer public
sabotages.why: It is how a client reads the bytes.

sabotages.name: Data::into_parts is no longer public
sabotages.why: It is how a client takes the chunk to keep or drop.

sabotages.name: a shrink's last known length is no longer public
sabotages.why: A client reads both lengths by name.

sabotages.name: Chunk is no longer exported from the reader module
sabotages.why: A client names the chunk it holds.

sabotages.name: control: the reader module exports its entry types in another order
sabotages.why: The order of a use list is not a promise.
find: pub use crate::read_sq::{Data, ReadDrain, ReadEntry, ReadSq, Shrink};
replace: pub use crate::read_sq::{Shrink, ReadSq, ReadEntry, ReadDrain, Data};

sabotages.name: TailReader::new is no longer public
sabotages.why: A caller outside the crate makes and drives the reader through it.

sabotages.name: TailReader::with_diagnostics is no longer public
sabotages.why: A caller outside the crate makes and drives the reader through it.

sabotages.name: TailReader::register is no longer public
sabotages.why: A caller outside the crate makes and drives the reader through it.

sabotages.name: TailReader::poll is no longer public
sabotages.why: A caller outside the crate makes and drives the reader through it.

sabotages.name: TailReader::read_sq is no longer public
sabotages.why: A caller outside the crate makes and drives the reader through it.

sabotages.name: TailReader::shutdown is no longer public
sabotages.why: A caller outside the crate makes and drives the reader through it.

sabotages.name: TailReader::take_failure is no longer public
sabotages.why: A caller outside the crate makes and drives the reader through it.

sabotages.name: TailRegistration::id is no longer public
sabotages.why: A caller reads a registration through it.

sabotages.name: TailRegistration::value is no longer public
sabotages.why: A caller reads a registration through it.

sabotages.name: TailRegistration::start_offset is no longer public
sabotages.why: A caller reads a registration through it.

sabotages.name: TailReader and TailRegistration are no longer exported from the reader module
sabotages.why: A caller names the reader it holds.

sabotages.name: TailReaderError is no longer exported from the reader module
sabotages.why: A caller names the error it handles.
